Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study is a descriptive classification of biological sex using proteomics (AMELY/AMELX) rather than a perturbation experiment. The 'case' is the specific archaeological find ('Lovers of Modena') and the 'controls' are known-sex samples used to validate the method. Because it is a case-control comparison of biological status, it is mapped to the disease/clinical state category as the closest fit for a non-perturbation case-control structure.
